_comment: THE edition catalogue. It used to be two hand-written lists — Swift's
TafsirCatalog.allIncludingUnreviewed and Kotlin's TafsirInfo.ALL_INCLUDING_UNREVIEWED —
that had to match with nothing enforcing it. This file replaces both: the
generator copies these rows into dist/manifest.json, which ships with the
data, and both apps parse it. Adding an edition is a row here plus a tree
under tafsir/<slug>/, never a Swift or Kotlin edit.
A row here MUST have a tree on disk: the generator fails closed rather than
ship a catalogue entry with no data. A tree on disk with no row here is not
bundled, and the generator says so out loud.
'language' is a code. The display string and the flag stay per-platform.
'id' is stable and load-bearing — it is what a user's saved preference
points at. FREE_ID = 169 lives in app code: that is monetization, not data.
'attribution_required' true with an empty 'attribution' is a build failure,
and the reader refuses to open such a bundle at all.
The German row is de-mourad (Erläuterung des Koran, DIdI e.V., 12 vols),
extracted from the publisher's own Word sources — see
tafsir/de-mourad/PROVENANCE.md. It is gated: awaiting_scholarly_review is
true (ADR-013) and the ADR-013 scholar-of-record slot is still empty.
ITS ATTRIBUTION IS A PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER, NOT APPROVED WORDING. DIdI
administers the text as a waqf and reserves the right to approve reprints;
that is a named channel, not a blanket licence like Rassoul's. The founder
is handling the rights conversation. The exact string DIdI requires replaces
the placeholder BEFORE the gate flips — the placeholder is worded so it
cannot be mistaken for approved text.
de-rassoul is ORPHANED: its tree is still on disk and has no row here, so
the generator does not bundle it and says so out loud. Deleting the tree is
a separate decision that has not been taken.

editions.name: Ibn Kathir
editions.author: Hafiz Ibn Kathir
editions._slug_note: misspelling is load-bearing — the corrected spelling 403s on the CDN and the slug is pinned by a test on both platforms. Do not fix.

editions.name: Erläuterung des Koran
editions.author: Samir Mourad
editions.attribution: PLATZHALTER — Genehmigung von DIdI e.V. ausstehend. Aus: Erläuterung des Koran (Tafsīr) von Samir Mourad, Deutscher Informationsdienst über den Islam (DIdI) e.V. Der Text ist ein Waqf; die Verwaltung erfolgt durch DIdI e.V.
editions._attribution_note: PROVISIONAL. Not approved by DIdI. Prefixed PLATZHALTER so it cannot ship unnoticed. Replace with DIdI's required wording before awaiting_scholarly_review flips.
editions._coverage_note: 6213/6236 ayahs (99.63%). The 23 gaps are silences in the printed book; 14 of them have commentary the book never keyed. See PROVENANCE.md.
editions._range_note: keys commentary to ayah RANGES — only 329 of 1505 blocks are single-ayah, median 3, largest 26:10-68 (59 ayahs). Whether the range or the ayah is the display unit is an open eng-lead call (ADR-012 parity gate).
